blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: With limited annotation budgets, choosing which images to label determines how much a model improves. Data-selection methods that use features from a separately trained model, or scene descriptions written by vision-language models, have been successful, but those signals do not directly capture changes in the model being improved. The target model’s own internal features reflect what it has learned so far and change with retraining, making them a natural cue for choosing the next training data. However, feature rarity alone does not reveal the errors that matter for performance. Here we link internal features to prediction errors and their expected impact on performance and select images for labeling and retraining without using labels for candidate images. We evaluated the method with an object detector on two datasets and two pairs of random seeds. Adding internal features improved the identification of prediction errors in 15 of 16 conditions. When performance was averaged over successive labeling rounds, the method outperformed selection based only on feature rarity in all four evaluation settings and ranked among the top two of six methods. With other conditions held fixed, performance after retraining was again higher than with rarity-based selection, even though the latter collected more errors. With longer retraining, the proposed method ranked first among six methods. These results suggest that linking a model’s internal features to its errors and their effects on performance may help select training images that improve performance, thereby allowing the model’s current state to guide which images are labeled next.
blocks.zh: 使用有限的注释预算,选择哪些图像来标签决定一个模型的改进程度. 使用单独训练的模型的特性或由视觉语言模型编写的场景描述的数据选择方法已经成功,但这些信号并没有直接捕捉正在改进的模型的变化. 目标模式本身的内部特征反映了它迄今为止学到的知识,并随着再培训而改变,使其成为选择下一个培训数据的自然提示。 然而,单凭特征的罕见性并不能发现对业绩很重要的错误。 在这里,我们将内部特征与预测错误及其预期对性能的影响联系起来,并选择用于标签和再培训的图像,而不使用候选图像的标签. 我们在两个数据集和两对随机种子上用一个物体探测器评估了这个方法。 在16个条件中的15个条件中,增加内部特征改善了预测错误的识别. 当业绩平均高于连续几轮的标签时,该方法的成绩仅优于所有四种评价设置中的特征稀有性,在六种方法中排名前两名。 随着其他条件的固定,再培训后的业绩再次高于罕见的选择,尽管后者收集了更多的错误。 通过较长的再培训,拟议方法在六种方法中排名第一。 这些结果表明,将模型的内部特性与其错误及其对性能的影响联系起来,可能有助于选择能提高性能的训练图像,从而使模型的目前状态能够指导下一步给哪些图像贴上标签.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The performance of supervised machine learning depends on the model size, the data selected for labeling, label accuracy, and the stage at which the data are introduced during training. In practice, experts have limited time and resources for labeling and verification, and data quality problems can persist from training to deployment [ 1 ] . Active label cleaning selects records for review according to their likelihood of containing errors and the effort required to verify them, rather than reviewing every label, and can improve the data quality under a fixed budget [ 2 ] . The combination of active and self-supervised learning can also improve performance while reducing the number of labels required, thereby increasing annotation efficiency [ 3 ] . Data-centric AI treats data collection, selection, labeling, and quality control as iterative processes guided by downstream model performance [ 4 , 5 ] . For image-based models, this raises the question of which images should be selected for further labeling or inclusion in training, and how the current state of the model should inform that choice.
blocks.zh: 受监督的机器学习的性能取决于模型大小,为标签选择的数据,标签准确性,以及培训期间引入数据的阶段. 实际上,专家在标签和核查方面的时间和资源有限,从培训到部署的数据质量问题可能持续存在。 主动标签清理根据包含错误的可能性和核实错误所需的努力来选择审查记录,而不是审查每个标签,并且可以在固定预算下提高数据质量[2]. 主动学习与自我监督学习相结合,也可以提高性能,同时减少所需的标签数量,从而提高注释效率[3]. 数据中心 大赦国际将数据收集、选择、标签和质量控制视为以下游模型性能为指导的迭代过程[4、5]。 就基于图像的模型而言,这就提出了这样一个问题,即应选择哪些图像作为进一步标签或纳入培训,以及模型的现状应如何为这一选择提供参考。

blocks.en: However, selecting images that a model has difficulty processing does not necessarily improve performance. High-loss images may include useful examples from which the model has not yet learned. However, they may also include duplicates, noisy images or labels, and examples from which the current model cannot benefit under the existing training procedure. Studies that distinguish learnability from the ability to generalize have found that substantial training effort can be spent on unnecessary or unsuitable data [ 6 ] . The value of an image also depends on model maturity: typical examples may benefit an immature model, whereas atypical examples may become more useful later in training [ 7 ] . Therefore, the value of additional images should be assessed over a learning curve rather than at a single label budget. This distinction suggests two separate tasks: identifying images on which the current model is likely to err and determining whether selected images improve the model after retraining.
blocks.zh: 然而,选择一个模型处理有困难的图像并不一定能提高性能. 高损失图像可能包括模型尚未从中吸取的有用实例. 然而,它们也可能包括重复、吵闹的图像或标签,以及现有模式在现有培训程序下无法获益的例子。 将可学习性与一般化能力区分开来的研究发现,大量培训工作可以花在不必要的或不适当的数据上[6]. 图像的价值还取决于模型的成熟度:典型的例子可能有利于不成熟的模型,而非典型的例子在后来的培训中可能变得更加有用[7]. 因此,额外图像的价值应当通过学习曲线而不是单一标签预算来评估。 这种区分提出了两个不同的任务:确定当前模型可能错误的图像,以及确定选定的图像在再培训后是否改进模型.

blocks.en: Active learning identifies unlabeled data that are expected to benefit a model and selects them for labeling [ 8 , 9 ] . We use the term selection method to refer to the rule that determines which images should be labeled next. In deep learning, selection methods include predictive uncertainty [ 10 ] , core-set selection, which aims to cover the image feature space [ 11 ] , and BADGE, which combines output uncertainty with diversity in gradient representations [ 12 ] . For object detection, selection methods have used classification and localization distributions [ 13 ] , entropy and diversity [ 14 ] , consistency under image transformations [ 15 ] , and internal features combined with uncertainty [ 16 ] . The performance of deep active learning can depend on random seeds for image selection and model training, the initial labeled sets, annotation budgets, retraining procedures, and evaluation protocols. One method may outperform random selection under one set of conditions but not another [ 17 ] . Therefore, evidence from a single pair of random seeds or a single label budget may be insufficient to establish an advantage over random sampling. We used two pairs of image-selection and model-training seeds and compared the methods over complete learning curves.
blocks.zh: 积极学习识别预期会有利于模型的无标签数据,并选择它们作为标签[8,9]. 我们使用术语选择方法来指代决定下一步应该给哪些图像贴标签的规则. 在深度学习中,选择方法包括预测不确定性[10],核心设置选择,旨在覆盖图像特征空间[11],以及将输出不确定性与梯度表示的多样性相结合的BADGE[12]. 对于对象检测,选择方法使用了分类和本地化分布[13],py和多样性[14],图像转换下的一致性[15],以及内部特征与不确定性[16]相结合. 深层主动学习的性能可以依靠随机种子进行图像选择和模型训练,初始的标注集,注释预算,再培训程序,以及评价协议. 一种方法可能在一套条件下超过随机选择,但另一种条件则不能超过[17]。 因此,单对随机种子或单一标签预算提供的证据可能不足以确立比随机抽样的优势。 我们使用了两对图像选择和模型训练种子,并比较了方法而不是完整的学习曲线。

blocks.en: Selection methods differ in both the features they use and their relationship to the model being trained. One successful line of work selects data using representations learned separately from the target model. In the fully supervised setting of those studies, TypiClust selects typical examples from diverse clusters in a self-supervised feature space, and ProbCover selects examples to cover the distribution in such a space [ 7 , 18 ] . More recently, vision-language models have been used to describe relevant detection scenarios in language and retrieve matching images for labeling, as in the AIDE data engine for autonomous driving [ 19 ] . These methods can characterize the data without relying on a target model trained on very few labels, but they rely on a separate model rather than on the behavior of the detector being trained. Neither a separately learned feature space nor a language description directly tracks changes in the target model’s parameters or its remaining errors as training proceeds. An image that is distinctive in that space need not provide information that would benefit the target model at its current stage. Annotation effort may therefore be directed toward images that are unusual in the external feature space but that the target detector already handles correctly. Conversely, errors in images that appear ordinary in that space may be overlooked. Diversity-based selection can thus choose images that provide the model with little new information [ 12 , 11 ] . In our comparison, this line of work is represented by k k -center selection on features from a separately pretrained ResNet-50. We chose it because it provides a simple implementation of the shared principle of covering an external feature space, has no component tied to the target detector, and can be applied identically at every stage and to every detector.
blocks.zh: 选择方法在使用的特点及其与正在培训的模型的关系上各不相同。 一个成功的工作领域利用从目标模型中分离出来的表述来选择数据。 在充分监督的这些研究的设置中,TypiClust从自我监督的特征空间中从不同的集群中选择典型的例子,ProbCover则选择实例来覆盖在这样一个空间中的分布[7,18]. 最近,视觉语言模型被用于描述语言中的相关检测情景,并检索匹配的图像进行标签,如AIDE数据引擎用于自主驱动[19]. 这些方法可以不依赖在极少数标签上受过训练的目标模型来描述数据,但它们依赖于单独的模型,而不是正在训练的探测器的行为. 单独学习的特征空间或语言描述都没有直接跟踪目标模型参数的变化或随着培训的进行而留下的错误。 该空间中独特的图像不需要提供有助于目标模型现阶段的信息。 因此,注解工作可以针对在外部特征空间中不寻常但目标探测器已经正确处理的图像。 相反,该空间中常见的图像错误可能被忽视。 因此,基于多样性的选择可以选择向模型提供很少新信息的图像[12,11]. 在我们的比较中,这一行的工作表现为从一个单独经过预先训练的ResNet-50的特性选择k-center。 我们之所以选择它,是因为它提供了对覆盖外部特征空间的共同原则的简单实施,没有与目标探测器相连的组件,并且可以在每一个阶段和每个探测器上同样应用.

blocks.en: The target model’s own internal features offer a different source of information: they are computed using its current parameters and change as the model is retrained. Existing approaches already use this connection. Core-set selection measures distances between representations produced by the target network, and BADGE combines the network’s internal representations with its current predictions to construct gradient embeddings [ 11 , 12 ] . This dependence on the target model motivates our use of internal features: they reflect how the model currently processes each image and may therefore help reveal its specific weaknesses. For an object detector, the features can be obtained during the same inference pass that produces the predicted boxes, without a separate feature extractor. The question is how to turn this information about the current model into a useful criterion for selecting its next training images.
blocks.zh: 目标模型本身的内部特点提供了不同的信息来源:它们是根据当前参数计算的,随着模型的再训练而改变。 现有办法已经使用这种联系。 核心集选择测量目标网络生成的表示值之间的距离,而BADGE将网络的内部表示值与其当前构建梯度嵌入的预测值[11,12]相结合. 这种对目标模型的依赖促使我们使用内部特征:它们反映了模型目前如何处理每个图像,因此可能有助于揭示其具体弱点。 对于一个物体探测器来说,特性可以在产生预测的盒子的同一推论通行证期间获得,没有单独的特性提取器. 问题是如何将关于目前模型的这一信息变成选择其下一个培训图像的有用标准。

blocks.en: Using internal representations alone does not guarantee better performance. Selecting for feature-space coverage or gradient diversity, as in core-set selection and BADGE [ 11 , 12 ] , does not explicitly distinguish error types and weight them by their effects on the evaluation metric. In particular, feature rarity does not directly indicate the probability of a classification or localization error, its effect on performance, or whether retraining can correct it. We hypothesize that linking internal features to the target model’s prediction errors and their expected impact on performance can make those features more useful for image selection. This principle may also be applicable to other learning tasks in which error types and their effects on an evaluation metric can be defined. We tested this hypothesis for object detection.
blocks.zh: 仅利用内部陈述并不能保证业绩更好。 选择特征-空间覆盖或梯度多样性,如在核心设置选择和BADGE[11,12]中,没有明确区分错误类型,并根据其对评价衡量标准的影响来权衡它们。 特别是,特征稀有性并不直接表明一个分类或本地化错误的概率,其对性能的影响,或者再培训是否能够纠正. 我们假设,将内部特征与目标模型的预测错误及其预期对性能的影响联系起来,可以使这些特征更有利于图像选择。 这一原则也可适用于可以界定错误类型及其对评价衡量标准的影响的其他学习任务。 我们测试了这个假说用于探测物体.

blocks.en: For object detection, the target detector predicts bounding boxes and class labels for objects in each image. Errors can arise from incorrect class labels, inaccurate box locations, duplicate detections, predictions on background regions, or missed objects. These error types can affect evaluation metrics differently. The Toolbox for Identifying Detection Errors (TIDE) attributes the losses in detection performance to these error types [ 20 ] . However, classifying errors based on ground truth differs from predicting errors in unlabeled images before selection. Detector confidence or class probabilities are commonly used as indicators of prediction uncertainty, but neural network probabilities are not necessarily calibrated [ 21 ] . In object detection, calibration error can also vary with the position and size of the predicted bounding box [ 22 ] . Thus, low confidence alone does not indicate that a prediction is erroneous, that the error is worth correcting, or that the corresponding image would be useful for further training. Certain post-processing methods use detector outputs alone to estimate whether a predicted box is correct [ 23 ] . However, they do not use internal representations and reduce errors to a distinction between true and false positives. When used independently, internal features and output uncertainty do not identify errors in an image or indicate how those errors relate to performance after retraining.
blocks.zh: 对于物体探测,目标探测器预测每个图像中对象的边框和类标签. 错误可能源于分类标签不正确,框位置不准确,检测重复,背景区域预测,或缺失对象. 这些错误类型可能以不同方式影响评价衡量标准. 识别检测错误的工具箱(TIDE)将检测性能的损失归为这些错误类型[20]. 然而,根据地面真伪对错误进行分类不同于在选择前对无标签图像中的错误进行预测. 探测器置信度或类概率通常用作预测不确定性的指标,但神经网络概率不一定被校准[21]. 在对象检测中,校准错误也可能随预测的边框位置和大小而变化[22]. 因此,信心不足本身并不表明预测是错误的,错误值得纠正,或者相应的形象对进一步培训有用。 某些后处理方法仅使用探测器输出来估计一个预测框是否正确 [23]. 但是,它们并不使用内部表述,而是将错误减少为真假阳性之间的区别. 在独立使用时,内部特征和输出不确定性无法识别图像中的错误,也无法说明这些错误与再培训后的性能有何关系.

blocks.en: In this study, we therefore use the errors made by the target model and their expected effects on performance to guide image selection. We estimated the type and probability of each prediction error from the target model’s internal representations and outputs without using ground-truth annotations for the candidate images and combined these estimates with the expected effect of each error on the current evaluation metric. We did not attempt to predict whether training with an image would correct the errors associated with it. Instead, we changed only the selection method, retrained the same model using the same procedure, and evaluated the selection cue using performance over the resulting learning curve.
blocks.zh: 因此,在这项研究中,我们利用目标模型的错误及其对性能的预期影响来指导图像选择. 我们从目标模型的内部表述和产出中估计了每个预测错误的类型和概率,但没有对候选图像使用地面真实说明,并将这些估计与每个错误对目前评价尺度的预期影响结合起来。 我们没有试图预测用图像进行的培训是否会纠正与之相关的错误。 相反,我们只改变了选择方法,使用同样的程序重新训练了同一个模型,并用在所形成的学习曲线上的性能来评价选择提示。

blocks.en: In the proposed method, the target detector trained on the current labeled set is fixed and runs on all unlabeled candidates. The error type and error probability of each predicted box are estimated from the internal features, final outputs, and position and size of the box. Each error-type probability is weighted by the change in average precision (AP) that would follow if the errors of that type were replaced by correct predictions, and the weighted values are then summed within the image. The sufficiency of the evidence, the stability of the estimate under resampling of the predicted boxes, and an estimate of relative annotation effort computed from the number and crowding of predicted boxes are then considered together to determine the image priority (Fig. Introduction ). The selection starts from a random draw obtained using the same image-selection seed. Candidates are matched to random images with similar predicted classes, object counts, object sizes, and internal features, and a random image is replaced only when the candidate’s priority is clearly judged to be higher. When the evidence is insufficient for determining priority, the random draw is retained. Annotations are revealed only after selection, and selection and retraining are repeated as the labeled fraction of candidate images increases from 5% to 25%.
blocks.zh: 在拟议方法中,在目前贴标签的套装上训练的目标探测器是固定的,并运行在所有未贴标签的候选人上. 每个预测框的误差类型和误差概率根据框的内部特性,最终输出,位置和大小来估计. 每个误差类型的概率都通过平均精度(AP)的变化进行加权,如果该类型的误差被正确的预测所取代,然后加权值在图像中进行总和. 然后,将证据的充分性、预测箱重印下的估计数的稳定性,以及从预测箱的数量和挤占量计算出的相对注解努力的估计数一并审议,以确定图像的优先顺序(图一)。 选择从使用相同的图像选择种子获得的随机绘图开始。 候选人被匹配到具有相似的预测类,对象计数,对象大小,以及内部特征的随机图像,只有在被明确判断为候选人优先级较高时,随机图像才会被替换. 当证据不足以确定优先权时,保留随机抽取. 说明只在甄选之后才公布,而且随着候选人图像的标注比例从5%增至25%,甄选和再培训会重复进行。

blocks.en: The primary analysis used YOLOv8n with COCO 2017 and BDD100K [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] . COCO 2017 contains everyday objects, whereas BDD100K contains driving scenes. Together, they allowed us to test the selection principle across two distinct image domains. For each dataset, we used image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1, and image-selection seed 18 with model-training seed 0. The second pair was used to test whether the direction of the results is reproduced when both seeds change. We compared six methods: the proposed method, random sampling, k k -center selection using features from a separate ResNet-50, BADGE adapted to object detection (hereafter BADGE), which uses internal representations and output uncertainty, output-entropy selection, and rarity-only selection based on internal representations. Within each dataset and seed condition, all methods started with the same labeled images and the same model trained on the initial 5% of labeled images (hereafter, the 5% model) and then increased the labeled fraction to 10, 15, 20, and 25%. These fractions refer to detector-training images. They exclude a separate labeled set of 1,500 images that the proposed method uses to fit, tune, and evaluate its error estimator (Methods). Our primary metric was the normalized area under the five-point learning curve. We connected the mAP@[0.50:0.95] (mean average precision over box-overlap thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, hereafter mAP) values at each point with straight line segments, integrated the resulting curve using the trapezoidal rule, and divided the area by the 0.20 width of the label range. A matched comparison from the same 10% model to the 15% model isolated the difference between linking internal representations to prediction errors and selecting images based on representation rarity. We report both the number of true errors in the selected images and the mAP after retraining. Thus, the comparison tests whether collecting more errors coincides with improved performance. A supplementary evaluation used Faster R-CNN with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1 to compare the proposed method, BADGE, and rarity-only selection using the corresponding 5% model for each dataset. We also tested the sensitivity to the training time in a BDD100K experiment that trained every stage for 40 epochs from the same 5% model.
blocks.zh: 初级分析使用YOLOv8n与CO2017和BDD100K[24,25,26]. COCO 2017包含日常物品,而BDD100K包含驾驶场景. 它们共同使我们能够在两个不同的图像领域测试选择原则。 每个数据集,我们使用图像选择种子11与模型训练种子1,图像选择种子18与模型训练种子 零点 第二对用于测试结果的方向是否在两种种子都改变时被复制. 我们比较了6种方法:拟议方法、随机抽样、使用单独的ResNet-50特性的 k-center选择、适应对象检测的BADGE(以下简称BADGE),后者使用内部表达和输出不确定性、输出-内向选择,以及基于内部表达的罕见选择。 在每个数据集和种子条件中,所有方法都以相同的标注图像和相同的模型开始,对最初5%的标注图像(以下称5%模型)进行培训,然后将标注分数增加到10、15、20和25%。 这些分数指的是探测器训练图像. 它们排除了一组单独的标注图案,其中1500幅图案是拟议方法用来适应,调谐和评价其误差估计器(Methods)的. 我们的主要衡量标准是五点学习曲线下的正常化领域。 我们用直线段连接了mAP@[0.50:0.95](在盒式重叠阈值上的平均精度从0.50到0.95,以下简称mAP)每一点的值,利用tapezoidal规则整合了产生的曲线,将区域除以标签范围的0.20宽. 从相同的10%模型到15%模型的匹配比较,隔离了将内部表示与预测错误相联系与根据表示罕见性选择图像之间的区别. 我们既报告所选图像中的真实错误数量,又报告再培训后的mAP. 因此,比较检验收集更多错误是否与改进的性能相吻合。 一项补充评价使用更快的R-CNN与图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1来比较拟议方法BADGE,并使用每个数据集相应的5%模型进行稀有选择. 我们还在BDD100K实验中测试了对训练时间的敏感性,该实验对来自同一5%模型的40个世纪的每个阶段进行了训练.

blocks.en: We show that internal features identified the detector’s erroneous predictions more accurately than an estimator without them in 15 of 16 conditions. We also demonstrate that error-linked selection outperforms rarity-only selection in a matched comparison, although the latter collected more true errors. The proposed method ranked among the top two of the six methods in all four main conditions and first of six when every stage was retrained for 40 epochs. Under the conditions examined, the errors of the current model and their effects on the evaluation metric were more useful cues for choosing training images than the rarity of the internal representation.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,在16个条件中的15个条件下,内部特征识别出探测器的错误预测比估计器更准确。 我们还表明,与错误相关的选择在比较中优于稀有选择,尽管后者收集了更多的真实错误。 在所有四个主要条件下,拟议方法在六种方法中排名前2位,在每阶段重新培训40个世纪时排名前6位。 在所审查的条件下,现行模式的错误及其对评价衡量标准的影响比内部代表性的罕见性更有助于选择培训图像。

blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: Internal features improved identification of the detector’s erroneous predictions
blocks.zh: 内部特征改进了探测器错误预测的识别

blocks.en: Adding internal features improved the identification of erroneous detector predictions for candidate images, without using ground-truth annotations. We evaluated this ability using a reserved set of 375 images with ground truth annotations. These images were not used for training or tuning. Therefore, the actual outcome of each predicted box served as a reference. An estimator that used internal features, outputs, and box information was compared with an estimator that only used outputs and box information. The ability of each estimator to identify erroneous predictions was measured using the area under the precision–recall curve (AUPRC), corrected for the prevalence of each error type, and averaged over the types. Across the 16 conditions (two datasets, two pairs of image-selection and model-training seeds, and four selection stages), the estimator with internal features scored higher in 15 of the 16 conditions (Fig. Internal features improved identification of the detector’s erroneous predictions ). In those same 15 conditions, the lower bound of the one-sided 90% interval obtained by resampling the images was above zero. In terms of error type, internal features increased AUPRC under all 16 conditions for background false positives, duplicate detections, and localization errors. The addition of internal features increased AUPRC under 12 conditions for combined classification and localization errors, and under only two conditions for classification errors.
blocks.zh: 增加内部功能有助于识别对候选图像的错误探测器预测,而不使用地面真实说明。 我们使用一套保留下来的375幅图像,并附有地面真相说明,来评估这种能力。 这些图像没有用于训练或调音。 因此,每个预测箱的实际结果可作为参考。 将使用内部特征、产出和框信息的估算器与只使用产出和框信息的估算器进行比较。 使用精度-召回曲线(AUPRC)下的区域测量了每个估计者识别错误预测的能力,纠正了每种错误类型的普遍程度,并按类型进行了平均。 在16个条件中(两个数据集、两对图像选择和模式训练种子以及四个选择阶段),具有内部特征的估算器在16个条件中的15个条件中得分较高(图:内部特征改善了探测器错误预测的识别)。 在同样的15个条件下,通过对图像进行复制而获得的单侧90%间隔的下限高于零。 在错误类型方面,内部特性在背景假阳性、重复检测和本地化错误的所有16个条件下都增加了AUPRC。 增加内部特征增加了AUPRC在12个条件下合并分类和本地化错误,只有两个条件下分类错误.

blocks.en: Our main aim was to identify likely errors for image selection rather than to improve probability calibration (Fig. Internal features improved identification of the detector’s erroneous predictions ). Adding internal features reduced the Brier score in 4 of the 16 conditions, the negative log-likelihood in 5, and the adaptive expected calibration error in 3 (Supplementary Fig. 1). These measures assess the error probability estimates themselves. Subsequent analyses assess their use in image selection.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要目的是找出可能的错误来选择图像,而不是改进概率校准(图. 内部特征改进了探测器错误预测的识别)。 增加内部特征降低了16个条件中的4个条件中的布赖尔分数,5个条件中的负对数相似,3个条件中的适应性预期校准错误(补充图1). 这些措施评估了误差概率本身。 随后的分析评估了它们在图像选择中的使用.

blocks.en: Linking internal representations to prediction errors improved whole-curve performance
blocks.zh: 将内部表述与预测错误挂钩,提高了全曲线性能

blocks.en: The normalized area under the learning curve (AULC) represents the average performance as the labeled fraction increases from 5% to 25%. Within each dataset and seed condition, the six methods started from a shared 5% model whose weights and model state were verified as identical using SHA-256 hashes. The mAP values of the shared 5% models were 11.290 and 10.732 on BDD100K for image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1 and for image-selection seed 18 with model-training seed 0, respectively, and 13.528 and 13.268 on COCO 2017 for the same two seed pairs.
blocks.zh: 学习曲线(AULC)下的正常化区域代表平均性能,因为标注分数从5%增加到25%。 在每个数据集和种子状况中,六种方法从一个共享的5%模型开始,其重量和模型状态用SHA-256散列物被验证为完全相同. 共享5%型号的mAP值分别为11.290和10.732 BDD100K,用于图像选择种子11和模式训练种子1,图像选择种子18和模式训练种子0,COCO 2017上为13.528和13.268,用于同一两个种子对.

blocks.en: The proposed method ranked first, second, second, and first under the four conditions (Table Linking internal representations to prediction errors improved whole-curve performance , Fig. Linking internal representations to prediction errors improved whole-curve performance ). Its margin over rarity-only selection ranged from +0.611 to +1.113 points, and the conditional 95% intervals from 10,000 matched resamples of the evaluation images were above zero for all four conditions. The margin over output-entropy selection ranged from +0.355 to +1.120 points, with all four intervals above zero. The margin over BADGE ranged from +0.175 to +1.126 points. The point estimates were positive in all four conditions. However, the conditional 95% interval was above zero in three conditions and included zero for COCO 2017 with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法在四个条件下排名第一、第二、第二和第一(将内部表述与预测错误挂钩表改善了全曲线性能)。 将内部表述与预测错误联系起来,提高了全曲线性能。 它相对于稀有选择的比值从+0.611到+1.113点不等,所有四个条件的有条件的95%间隔从10,000个匹配的评价图像复标值都高于零. 输出内置选择的比值从+0.355到+1.120点不等,所有四个间隔都高于零. 相对于BADGE的比值从+0.175到+1.126点不等. 在所有四个条件中,点数估计数都是积极的。 然而,有条件的95%间隔在3个条件下为0以上,并包含COCO 2017的0,包含图像选择赛种子11和模式训练种子1.

blocks.en: Compared with external-feature k k -center selection, the point estimate of the proposed method was higher in three of the four conditions and 0.459 points lower on BDD100K with image-selection seed 18 and model-training seed 0. Compared with random sampling, the normalized area under the learning curve of the proposed method was higher in three of the four conditions and 0.120 points lower on COCO 2017 with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1. The interval for the difference from random sampling was above zero on BDD100K with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1, and on COCO 2017 with image-selection seed 18 and model-training seed 0, whereas it included zero in the other two conditions. A sensitivity analysis recalculated the 20 pairwise differences between the proposed method and the five comparators across the four experimental conditions using only the 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% labeled-data points and excluding the shared 5% starting point. The direction of all 20 differences remained unchanged.
blocks.zh: 与外缘的 k- center 选择相比, 4 个条件中的 3 个条件对拟议方法的点估计值更高, BDD100K 上低 0. 459 分, 图像选择种子 18 和模型训练种子 零点 与随机采样相比,拟议方法的学习曲线下的常态化区域在四个条件中的三个条件中较高,COCO 2017年的0.120分更低,有图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1. 随机采样差异的间隔时间在BDD100K上为0以上,有图像选择种子11和模式训练种子1,COCO上为2017年,有图像选择种子18和模式训练种子0,而在另外两个条件下则包括0. 灵敏度分析重新计算了拟议方法与四个实验条件的五个参照国之间的20对比差异,只使用10%,15%,20%和25%的标签数据点,不包括共享的5%起点. 所有20个差异的方向保持不变。

blocks.en: Selection linking internal representations to prediction errors outperformed rarity-only selection
blocks.zh: 选择将内部表示与预测错误联系起来,其效果高于仅以罕见方式选择

blocks.en: At the 15% labeled-data level with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1, we held the starting model, candidate images, maximum number of replaced images, training conditions, and evaluation method fixed and changed only the criterion used to prioritize images. The replacement cap was 1,684 images on BDD100K and 2,894 on COCO 2017, half of the images added at that stage. The proposed method replaced 1,684 and 264 images, respectively. The numbers of images replaced under the other three criteria were not retrieved from the run records. The proposed method exceeded rarity-only selection by 0.313 points on BDD100K, with a conditional 95% interval of +0.081 to +0.520 from resampling the evaluation images with the trained models fixed, and by 0.625 points on COCO 2017 with an interval of +0.238 to +1.028 (Fig. Selection linking internal representations to prediction errors outperformed rarity-only selection ).
blocks.zh: 在15%的标注数据级别上,我们拥有图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1,我们持有起始模型,候选图像,最大替换图像数量,训练条件,以及评价方法固定下来,只修改了用于排列图像优先次序的标准. 更换封顶为BDD100K上的1,684幅图像和COCO 2017上的2,894幅图像,占该阶段新增图像的一半. 拟议方法分别取代了1 684幅和264幅图像。 根据其他三项标准替换的图像数量没有从运行记录中检索。 提议的方法在BDD100K上超过仅限稀有选择0.313分,有条件的95%间隔为+0.081至+0.520,与训练有素的固定模型重印评价图像,COCO 2017上0.625分,间隔为+0.238至+1.028(图. 选择将内部表示与预测差错联系起来,结果超过仅限稀有选择).

blocks.en: The rarity-only selection method selected images containing more true errors: 8,641.627 per 100 images on BDD100K and 8,637.640 on COCO 2017, compared with 8,319.952 and 8,609.190, respectively, for the proposed method. However, the proposed method achieved a higher mAP after retraining. Among all four criteria at the 15% labeled-data level, the proposed method ranked highest on COCO 2017. For BDD100K, it was 0.019 points below the output-based criterion and 0.095 points below the criterion with internal features shuffled across images. These results support two limited conclusions: (a) solely collecting more true errors does not explain the performance after retraining, and (b) the proposed method differs from the rarity-only selection method by using predicted error types and their expected effects on the evaluation metric rather than feature rarity alone.
blocks.zh: 珍稀唯物选择方法选取了包含更真实错误的图像:BDD100K上每100个图像8,641.627,COCO2017上每100个图像8,637.640,而拟议方法则分别是8,319.952和8,609.190. 然而,拟议方法在再培训后实现了较高的硕士水平。 在15%的标签数据级别上的所有四项标准中,拟议方法在COCO 2017上排名最高. 对于BDD100K来说,它比基于输出的标准低0.019分,比标准低0.095分,内部特征横跨图像. 这些结果支持两个有限的结论:(a) 仅仅收集更真实的错误并不能解释再培训后的业绩,(b) 拟议方法与罕见的选择方法不同,采用预测的错误类型及其对评价衡量尺度的预期影响,而不只是特征。

blocks.en: Replacement behavior remained consistent when the image-selection and model-training seeds changed
blocks.zh: 当图像选择和模型训练种子发生变化时,替换行为仍然一致

blocks.en: For the proposed method and BADGE, we retrieved the selected image IDs and selection summaries saved at every cycle and verified against a sealed hash manifest for eight experiments comprising two datasets, two methods, and two seed conditions (image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1, and image-selection seed 18 with model-training seed 0).
blocks.zh: 就拟议方法和BADGE而言,我们检索了每个周期保存的选定图像ID和选择摘要,并对照密封的散列清单进行了核查,用于8项实验,包括两个数据集、两个方法和两个种子条件(图像选择种子11和模型培训种子1和图像选择种子18和模型培训种子0)。

blocks.en: Across all cycles, the proposed method replaced 6,703 images from the random draw on BDD100K with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1 and 6,676 with image-selection seed 18 and model-training seed 0. The replacement rate was approximately 49–50% per cycle under both conditions. On COCO 2017, it replaced 1,193 and 1,146 images, or approximately 4–6% per cycle. Thus, under both seed conditions, the method found many candidates that met the replacement criterion for BDD100K but retained most of the random draw on COCO 2017.
blocks.zh: 在所有周期中,拟议方法将BDD100K随机抽取的6 703幅图像替换为图像选取种子11和模型训练种子1和6 676,并更换成图像选取种子18和模型训练种子0。 在这两种条件下,更换率约为每周期49-50%。 在COCO 2017上,它更换了1,193和1,146个图像,即每个周期大约4–6%. 因此,在这两种种子条件下,该方法都发现了许多符合BDD100K替换标准的候选者,但保留了COCO2017上的大部分随机抽取.

blocks.en: The Jaccard index between the selected sets of the proposed method and BADGE ranged from approximately 0.026 to 0.038 at each stage. These methods selected largely different images, and they used different selection rules and parent models after the first retraining stage. The comparison describes the consistency of the proposed method’s replacement behavior rather than the isolated effect of the error information.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法的选定套和BADGE之间的Jaccard指数在每个阶段大约为0.026至0.038。 这些方法选择了大致不同的图像,在第一次再培训阶段之后,它们使用了不同的选择规则和母模型. 比较说明拟议方法替换行为的一致性,而不是错误信息的孤立效果。

blocks.en: The proposed method achieved the highest whole-curve performance among six methods under 40-epoch retraining
blocks.zh: 拟议方法在40世纪再培训的6个方法中实现了最高的全曲线性能

blocks.en: To examine the sensitivity to training time, we restricted the experiment to YOLOv8n, BDD100K, image-selection seed 11, and model-training seed 1 and trained each of the five stages for 40 epochs. The prespecified scope of this sensitivity analysis comprised five methods: the proposed method, BADGE, k k -center selection on external features, random sampling, and output-entropy selection. Rarity-only selection, the sixth method of the main analysis, was evaluated under the same 40-epoch schedule from the identical 5% model in an additional comparison planned after the results of the original five methods had been observed. The normalized AULC values calculated from the official mAP values at 5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% labeled data were 18.874 for the proposed method, 18.672 for the external-feature k k -center, 18.113 for rarity-only selection, 18.107 for random sampling, 17.783 for BADGE, and 17.189 for output-entropy selection. The corresponding differences between the proposed method and the five comparators were +0.201, +0.760, +0.767, +1.090, and +1.684 points, respectively (Fig. The proposed method achieved the highest whole-curve performance among six methods under 40-epoch retraining , Supplementary Table 10). Rarity-only selection and random sampling differed by only 0.007 points.
blocks.zh: 为了检查对训练时间的敏感性,我们把实验限制在YOLOv8n,BDD100K,图像选择种子11,模型训练种子1上,并为40个世纪的五个阶段中每个阶段都进行了训练. 这一敏感性分析的预先确定范围包括五种方法:拟议方法、BADGE、关于外部特征的 kk-center 选择、随机抽样和输出内涵选择。 在观察了最初的五种方法的结果之后,在计划的额外比较中,按照相同的5%模式的40个划时代时间表,评价了唯一选择瑞丽的方法。 从官方的mAP值中计算出来的AULC值为:拟议方法为18.874,外部环境为18.672 k-center,仅选择稀有物为18.113,随机抽样为18.107,BADGE为17.783,产出为17.189。 拟议方法与五个参照国的相应差异分别为+0.201,+0.760,+0.767,+1.090和+1.684分(图. 拟议方法在40世纪再培训的6个方法中取得了最高的全曲线性能,补充表10。 仅限瑞丽选择和随机采样只差0.007分.

blocks.en: The conditional 95% intervals from 10,000 resamples of the evaluation images with the trained models fixed were +0.062 to +0.357 points for the difference from the external-feature k k -center, +0.620 to +0.905 for rarity-only selection, +0.621 to +0.930 for random sampling, +0.946 to +1.260 for BADGE, and +1.497 to +1.876 for output-entropy selection. All five were above zero (Fig. The proposed method achieved the highest whole-curve performance among six methods under 40-epoch retraining ). When the shared 5% point was excluded, the differences calculated from the 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% labeled-data points remained positive at +0.217, +0.904, +0.893, +1.285, and +1.980.
blocks.zh: 附加条件的95%间隔,从10 000个带有训练有素的模型的评价图像的复标值为+0.062至+0.357分,与外缘k-中心值的差值为+0.620至+0.905分,仅限稀有物选择值为+0.621至+0.930分,随机取样为+0.946至+1.260分,BADGE为+1.497至+1.876分,输出物选择值为+1.876分. 5人以上均为零(图. 拟议的方法在40世纪再培训的六个方法中实现了最高的全曲线性能。 当排除共享的5%点时,从10%,15%,20%和25%的标注数据点计算出的差值在+0.217,+0.904,+0.893,+1.285,+1.980时仍然为正数.

blocks.en: The six methods started from the same 5% model, with identical weights, model state, and initial labeled images. This model had an official mAP of 13.424. Therefore, the differences from 10% onward cannot be attributed to differences in training before the image-selection methods diverged.
blocks.zh: 六种方法起源于相同的5%模型,具有相同的重量,模型状态,以及初始的标注图像. 这个模型有一个13.424的正式mAP. 因此,与10%以上的差异不能归因于在图像选择方法不同之前的培训差异。

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: We selected training images based on the target model’s predicted errors and their expected effects on the evaluation metric rather than on image rarity or error counts alone. The internal features identified likely errors more accurately in 15 of the 16 conditions. We then evaluated the selected image sets using learning curves that began with a shared 5% model, together with a matched comparison at the 15% labeled-data level in which only the selection criterion was changed. In the whole-curve comparison, the proposed method outperformed the rarity-only selection method under all four conditions. It also ranked highest among the six methods on BDD100K when every stage was trained for 40 epochs.
blocks.zh: 我们根据目标模型的预测错误及其对评价尺度的预期影响,而不是仅仅根据图像稀有或错误来选择培训图像。 在16个条件中的15个条件中,内部特征更准确地发现了可能的错误。 然后,我们用从共享5%模型开始的学习曲线来评价选定的图像集,同时在15%的标签数据级别上进行匹配的比较,其中只修改了选择标准。 在全曲线比较中,拟议方法在所有四个条件下都超过了罕见的唯选方法。 在BDD100K上的六种方法中,它也排名最高,因为每个阶段都为40个世纪进行训练。

blocks.en: In the supplementary evaluation using Faster R-CNN, the proposed method, BADGE, and rarity-only selection started from the same 5% model within each dataset (Supplementary Table 9). The proposed method ranked third on BDD100K and first on COCO 2017. Its relative performance therefore differed between the datasets.
blocks.zh: 在使用更快的R-CNN进行的补充评价中,拟议方法BADGE和稀有选择从每个数据集中相同的5%模型开始(补充表9)。 拟议方法在BDD100K排名第三,在COCO2017排名第一. 因此,各数据集的相对性能不同。

blocks.en: In the main analysis using YOLOv8n, all methods started from the same 5% model within each dataset and seed condition. The proposed method ranked first, second, second, and first across the four conditions. It outperformed the rarity-only and output-entropy selections in all four conditions, with all conditional 95% intervals above zero. Its margin over BADGE was positive in all four conditions, with an interval above zero in three conditions. These consistently positive point estimates relative to comparators that use internal representations support linking those representations to prediction errors and their expected effects on the evaluation metric. Compared with external-feature k k -center selection and random sampling, the point estimate for the proposed method was higher in three of the four conditions, and lower in one. The sensitivity analysis based only on the 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% labeled-data points left the direction of these 20 comparisons unchanged.
blocks.zh: 在使用YOLOv8n的主要分析中,所有方法都是从每个数据集和种子条件内相同的5%模型开始的. 拟议方法在四个条件中排名第一,第二,第二,第一. 它在所有四个条件中都表现优于稀有的和输出的任意选择,所有有条件的95%的间隔都高于零. 其在BADGE的比值在所有四个条件下都是正值,在三个条件下的间隔均高于零. 与采用内部表述的比较国相比,这些一致的正点估计数支持将这些表述与预测错误及其预期对评价尺度的影响联系起来。 与外部环境k-center选择和随机抽样相比,拟议方法的点估计值在四个条件中的三个条件中较高,一个条件中较低。 仅根据10%、15%、20%和25%的标签数据点进行的敏感性分析,没有改变这20个比较的方向。

blocks.en: In the BDD100K experiment with 40 epochs at every stage, the proposed method ranked highest among the six methods that began with the same 5% model. The differences from the five comparators remained positive after excluding the shared starting point. Under the main retraining schedule for the same dataset and seed pair, the proposed method had a higher point estimate than each comparator, and these differences remained positive with longer training. The difference from the external-feature k k -center was +0.101 points under the main schedule, with a conditional 95% interval that included zero ( − 0.015 -0.015 to +0.205, Supplementary Table 6), and +0.201 points with 40 epochs, with an interval that excluded zero (+0.062 to +0.357). Both intervals were obtained by resampling the evaluation images with the trained models held fixed. The difference between these estimates does not establish whether longer training increases the gap between the methods. Instead, the experiment showed that the ordering was retained under a longer schedule.
blocks.zh: 在BDD100K实验中,每个阶段都有40个纪元,建议的方法在以同样5%的模型开始的6个方法中排名最高. 在排除了共同的起点之后,与五个参照国的差异仍然是积极的。 根据同一数据集和种子配对的主要再培训时间表,拟议方法的点数估计高于每个参照国,这些差异由于培训时间较长而仍然积极。 与外部地貌k-中点的区别是主计时表中的+0.101分,有条件的95%的间隔包括0(−0.015-0.015至+0.205,补充表6)和+0.201分的40个历程,间隔不包括0(+0.062至+0.357). 两个间隔都是通过用固定的训练有素的模型对评价图像进行复制而获得的。 这些估计数之间的差别不能确定较长的培训是否扩大了方法之间的差距。 相反,实验表明,订单是按更长的时间表保留的。

blocks.en: The scores with internal features singled out erroneous predictions more accurately under almost all evaluation conditions, most clearly for background false positives, duplicate detections, and localization errors. However, on the Brier score, negative log-likelihood, and expected calibration error, this approach did not consistently surpass the scores that used outputs and box information alone. Therefore, internal features improved the identification of which predictions were likely to be wrong but did not demonstrably improve the accuracy of the predicted probability values. As the proposed method determines replacements by comparing these stability bounds, probabilities that are lower than the truth render replacement less likely. The method handles this mismatch using temperature scaling, the weight given to internal features, the number of similar calibration examples, and the stability bounds. Making the predicted probabilities more accurate is an improvement separate from the ranking gain and is left for future work.
blocks.zh: 具有内部特征的分数在几乎所有评价条件下都单独列出更准确的错误预测,最明显的是背景假阳性,重复检测,以及本地化错误. 然而,在布赖尔得分,负对数相似以及预期校准错误方面,这种方法并没有始终超过仅使用产出和框信息的得分. 因此,内部特征改进了对哪些预测可能是错误的确定,但没有明显提高预测概率值的准确性。 由于拟议方法通过比较这些稳定性界限来决定替换,低于真相的概率使得替换的可能性降低. 该方法利用温度缩放,给内部特征的权重,类似校准实例的数量,稳定性界限来处理这种不匹配. 使预测概率更准确,是不同于排名收益的改进,留给未来工作。

blocks.en: Increasing diversity in the internal-representation space and improving detection performance after retraining are distinct objectives. In the matched comparison at the 15% labeled-data level with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1, the rarity-only selection method chose images containing more true errors. However, the proposed method had a higher mAP. Thus, collecting more true errors alone does not explain performance after retraining. Among the four criteria, the proposed method achieved the highest mAP on COCO 2017, whereas on BDD100K, its mAP was slightly lower than that of the output-based criterion and the criterion with internal features shuffled across images. Therefore, the independent effect of each component cannot be separated in this comparison.
blocks.zh: 增加内部代表空间的多样性和在再培训后改进检测工作是明确的目标。 在15%的标签数据级别上与图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1的匹配比较中,罕见的唯选方法选择了包含更真实错误的图像. 然而,拟议方法具有较高的mAP. 因此,仅仅收集更真实的错误并不能解释再培训后的表现。 在四项标准中,拟议方法在COCO 2017上实现了最高的mAP,而在BDD100K上,其mAP略低于基于输出的标准,以及具有内部特征的标准在图像上摇摆. 因此,在这个比较中不能将每个组成部分的独立效果分开.

blocks.en: The verified selection records showed that the proposed method replaced approximately half of the random draw on BDD100K and only approximately 4–6% on COCO 2017 under both seed conditions. This dataset-specific replacement pattern was consistent across the two seed pairs, indicating that the method retained the random draw when evidence for replacement was insufficient.
blocks.zh: 经核实的选拔记录显示,在两种种子条件下,拟议方法取代了BDD100K随机抽取的大约一半,而COCO 2017上则只取代了大约4-6 %. 这种数据集特有的替换模式在两种种子对之间是一致的,表明在替换证据不足时,该方法保留了随机抽取.

blocks.en: The performance of the proposed method relative to the external-feature k k -center and random sampling methods varied by dataset and seed condition. The proposed method achieved a higher normalized AULC than external-feature k k -center selection under both COCO 2017 conditions and on BDD100K with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1, but a lower AULC on BDD100K with image-selection seed 18 and model-training seed 0. It achieved a higher normalized AULC than random sampling under both BDD100K conditions and on COCO 2017 with image-selection seed 18 and model-training seed 0, but lower AULC on COCO 2017 with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1. The four conditions were too few to attribute these differences to dataset or seed effects. The combination of error-based selection with diversity-based selection across the entire image collection remains to be tested.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法相对于外缘k-center和随机抽样方法的性能因数据集和种子条件而异. 拟议方法在COCO 2017年条件下和BDD100K上实现了更高的常态化AULC,在图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1下,但在BDD100K上实现了较低的AULC,图像选择种子18和模型训练种子0. 它在BDD100K条件下以及在COCO 2017上实现了高于随机采样的AULC的常态化,有图像选择种子18和模型训练种子0,但在COCO 2017上则低于AULC,有图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1. 四个条件太少,无法将这些差异归因于数据集或种子效应。 在整个图像收藏中,基于错误的选择与基于多样性的选择相结合仍有待测试。

blocks.en: This study had five limitations. First, only two conditions with different image-selection and model-training seeds were used to examine whether the direction of the results was reproduced. This is not sufficient to estimate the distribution over other seeds. The 95% intervals for each setting express only the variation resulting from changing the evaluation images with the trained models fixed, and not the variation from repeating training or image selection. Second, the detector in the main analysis was YOLOv8n, and the supplementary comparison with Faster R-CNN was limited to one pair of image-selection and model-training seeds, two datasets, and three methods that use the internal representation. Random sampling, output-entropy selection, and external-feature selection were not evaluated with Faster R-CNN, and generalization to other detectors, datasets, or distribution shifts was not tested. Third, missed objects have no predicted box and hence no internal representation. Therefore, they are not included directly in the box-level error estimate. Fourth, adding internal features helped identify predictions that were likely to be errors but did not demonstrably improve the accuracy of the predicted probabilities. Fifth, savings in labeling and GPU time could not be established from the present results.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有五个局限性。 首先,只有两个条件具有不同的图像选择和模型训练种子,用来检查是否复制了结果的方向. 这不足以估计其他种子的分布情况。 每个设置的95%间隔仅表示使用经过训练的固定模型改变评价图像所产生的变化,而不是重复训练或图像选择所产生的变化。 其次,主分析中的探测器是YOLOv8n,与Seaster R-CNN的补充比较仅限于一对图像选择和模型训练种子,两个数据集,以及使用内部代表的三种方法. 随机采样,输出-内向选择和外向选择没有用更快的R-CNN来评价,一般化到其他探测器,数据集或分布转移没有经过测试. 第三,缺失的物体没有预测的盒子,因此没有内部代表。 因此,它们没有直接列入框级错误估计. 第四,增加内部特性有助于确定可能存在错误的预测,但没有明显提高预测概率的准确性。 第五,目前的结果无法确定标签和GPU时间的节省。

blocks.en: The value of the target model’s internal representations lies not only in their rarity but also in their relationship to the errors made by the current model. Our results supported this design under the conditions tested in this study. The proposed method outperformed random sampling and external-feature selection under three of the four conditions. Consequently, we do not claim an advantage in every setting.
blocks.zh: 目标模型内部表述的价值不仅在于其罕见性,也在于其与当前模型所犯错误的关系. 我们的成果支持在这项研究测试的条件下进行这一设计。 拟议方法在四个条件中的三个条件中,其业绩超过了随机抽样和外部特征选择。 因此,我们并不声称在各种情况下都有优势。

blocks.en: The proposed selection principle is not inherently specific to object detection. It requires an internal representation of each prediction, defined error types, and an estimate of the effect of each type on the evaluation metric. We chose object detection because its error types and their effects on the evaluation metric can be systematically characterized [ 20 ] . Thus, these requirements can be specified concretely. The same procedure may be applicable to image classification, segmentation, or sequence prediction whenever the error types and their effects on the metric can be defined. The evidence for the effectiveness of the method proposed in this study is limited to the YOLOv8n main analysis on two object-detection datasets and the restricted Faster R-CNN comparison. Its effectiveness on other tasks remains to be tested.
blocks.zh: 拟议的选择原则在本质上并不是针对对象检测的. 它要求内部代表每个预测,定义错误类型,以及估计每个类型对评价衡量标准的影响. 我们选择了对象检测,因为其错误类型及其对评价衡量标准的影响可以系统地定性为[20]. 因此,这些要求可以具体加以规定。 每当可以确定错误类型及其对度量的影响时,同样的程序也可能适用于图像分类、分区或序列预测。 本研究提出的方法有效性的证据仅限于YOLOv8n对两个对象检测数据集的主要分析以及限制性的更快R-CNN比较. 它在其他任务方面的效力仍有待检验。

blocks.en: Overall, the results indicate that information about the current prediction errors of the target model and their expected effects on the evaluation metric can provide a useful basis for selecting images for annotation and retraining. By linking the target model’s internal representations to prediction error types and their expected metric effects, the proposed method yielded higher post-retraining performance than rarity-only selection under the conditions examined. The results also show that collecting more true errors does not by itself explain the performance after retraining, and that the value of a selection method should be assessed over several labeled-data levels rather than at a single annotation budget. For BDD100K, the proposed method also performed better than all five comparators when the retraining was extended to 40 epochs at every stage. Combining error information with the diversity of the full image collection remains a direction for future study. The selection step of the proposed method requires one inference pass over the candidate images and the processing of a 1,500-image calibration set without an external model or additional detector training.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示,关于目标模型当前预测错误及其对评价衡量尺度的预期影响的信息可以为选择用于注释和再培训的图像提供有益的基础。 通过将目标模型的内部表述与预测错误类型及其预期的度量效应联系起来,拟议方法在所审查条件下的再培训后业绩高于罕见的选择。 调查结果还表明,收集更真实的错误本身并不能解释再培训后的绩效,而且选择方法的价值应评估在几个标注数据级别上,而不是在单一注释预算中。 就BDD100K而言,拟议方法也比所有五个比较国都好,因为再培训在每个阶段都扩大到40个世纪。 将错误信息与完整图像收集的多样性结合起来仍然是今后研究的方向。 拟议方法的甄选步骤要求通过一个推论来传递候选图像,并在没有外部模型或额外的探测器训练的情况下处理1500图像校准集.

blocks.en: Methods
blocks.zh: 方法

blocks.en: Overview of the study design
blocks.zh: 研究设计概述

blocks.en: The exploratory experiments used to develop the method and the comparisons reported herein were performed using different data splits, image-selection seeds, and model-training seeds. The comparators, data splits, initialization, evaluation metrics, and evaluation procedures were fixed for the reported comparisons, and the identifiers for each run’s configuration and artifacts were recorded.
blocks.zh: 用于开发这种方法的探索性实验和本报告所报告的比较是利用不同的数据分割、图像选择种子和模型培训种子进行的。 为报告的比较确定了比较、数据分割、初始化、评价指标和评价程序,并记录了每个运行的配置和文物的识别资料。

blocks.en: The main analysis employed YOLOv8n, COCO 2017, and BDD100K. The image-selection seed determines the initial labeled set and the random draw at each stage. The model-training seed determines the weight initialization, data order, and stochastic operations during training. Two conditions were used: image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1, and image-selection seed 18 with model-training seed 0. The seed values were fixed before the reported comparisons were run and carry no special meaning. The second pair was used to check whether the direction of the results was reproduced when both seeds changed. As both seeds changed simultaneously, their separate effects were not identified. Six methods were compared for each dataset and seed condition: the proposed method, random sampling, k k -center selection on external features, BADGE, output-entropy selection, and rarity-only selection based on the internal representation. Within each condition, the six methods shared the same initial labeled set and a 5% model whose identical weights were verified using SHA-256. They then proceeded to the 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25% labeled-data stages. The matched comparison, in which only the selection criterion changed in a single step from 10% to 15%, was treated as an additional mechanism analysis with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1, separate from the whole-curve comparison.
blocks.zh: 主要分析采用YOLOv8n,COCO 2017,和BDD100K. 图像选择种子决定了每个阶段的初始标签集和随机绘图. 模型-训练种子决定了训练期间的重量初始化,数据顺序,以及结构操作. 使用了两个条件:图像选择种子11与模型训练种子1,图像选择种子18与模型训练种子. 零点 在进行所报告的比较之前,种子数值是固定的,没有特殊的意义。 第二对用于检查结果的方向是否在两种种子都改变时被复制. 由于两种种子同时变异,它们各自的影响没有被识别出来. 比较了每个数据集和种子条件的6种方法:拟议方法、随机抽样、外部特征上的 k k - 中心选择、 BADGE、输出 - 切入选择以及基于内部代表的稀有选择。 在每种条件下,六种方法共用相同的初始标签集和一个使用SHA-256验证其相同重量的5%模型。 然后进入10%、15%、20%和25%的标注数据阶段。 相匹配的比较中,只有选择标准在单一步骤中从10%改为15%,这被视为与图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1的附加机制分析,与全曲线比较分开。

blocks.en: A supplementary comparison with a different detector used Faster R-CNN with a ResNet-50 backbone and a feature pyramid. The comparison was restricted to COCO 2017 and BDD100K, image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1, and three methods: the proposed method, BADGE, and rarity-only selection. This restriction reflects the scope of our claim, which concerns comparisons with existing methods that use internal representation, as well as the available computing budget, which allowed only these methods to be rerun from a shared 5% model. Random sampling, output-entropy selection, and external-feature k k -center selection were not run from the same 5% model for Faster R-CNN, and their comparisons were not part of the Faster R-CNN conclusions. The three methods for each dataset shared the same initial labeled set and 5% model. Data splits, label budgets, official evaluation rules, and the definition of each selection method were identical to those for YOLOv8n, whereas the detector architecture, initial weights, layers from which internal features were taken, and training implementation were fixed for Faster R-CNN. Faster R-CNN with a ResNet-50 backbone and feature pyramid was trained with stochastic gradient descent (learning rate 0.005, momentum 0.9, weight decay 0.0005) and a learning-rate schedule that reduced the learning rate by a factor of 10 after three epochs and restarted at each stage, with an effective batch size of 16, the same epoch schedule as YOLOv8n, and no data augmentation. This supplementary comparison was used to check whether the principle of linking the internal representations to prediction errors was also observed with a different detector architecture. It was not a controlled comparison in which only the detector architecture was changed.
blocks.zh: 与不同的探测器进行补充比较时,使用了带有ResNet-50主干线和特征金字塔的更快R-CNN. 比较仅限于COCO 2017年和BDD100K,图像选择种子11与模型训练种子1,以及三种方法:拟议方法BADGE和稀有选择. 这个限制反映了我们索赔的范围,它涉及与使用内部代表制的现有方法的比较,以及可用的计算预算,这使得这些方法只能从共享的5%模型中重新运行. 随机抽样、输出-内向选择和外部特性的 k - 中心选择没有从同一5%的模型中运行,用于更快的R-CNN,其比较不属于更快的R-CNN结论的一部分。 每个数据集的三种方法共享了相同的初始标签集和5%的模型. 数据分割,标签预算,官方评价规则,以及每种选择方法的定义与YOLOv8n相同,而探测器架构,初始权重,内部功能取材层,培训实施则固定在更快的R-CNN. 拥有ResNet-50主干线和特征金字塔的更快R-CNN接受了划时代梯度下降(学习速率0.005,动力0.9,重量衰减0.0005)和学习速率时间表的培训,在三个纪元后将学习速率降低10倍,并在每个阶段重新启动,有效批量大小为16,与YOLOv8n相同的划时代时间表,没有数据增强. 这一补充比较被用来检查将内部表述与预测错误挂钩的原则是否也与不同的探测器结构相符合。 它不是一个只改变探测器结构的控制比较。

blocks.en: Datasets and splits
blocks.zh: 数据集和拆分

blocks.en: COCO 2017 is a general object detection dataset with 80 object classes in everyday scenes [ 25 ] . BDD100K contains driving scenes captured at different times of day and under different weather and road conditions and uses 10 object classes [ 26 ] . In COCO 2017, 115,787 images were selected as candidates for labeling. In BDD100K, 67,363 of the 69,863 training images with detection annotations remained after excluding the images reserved for error estimation and internal validation and were used as candidate images. Image IDs, mappings between annotations and classes, and the SHA-256 hash of each split were recorded.
blocks.zh: COCO 2017是一般物体探测数据集,在日常场景中有80个物体类[25]. BDD100K包含在不同时间和不同天气及道路条件下捕获的驾驶场景,并使用10个物体类[26]. COCO 2017年,115,787张图片被选为标签候选人. 在BDD100K中,69 863个带有检测说明的训练图像中,有67 363个在排除了保留用于错误估计和内部验证的图像后仍保留下来,并作为候选图像使用. 记录了图像ID、说明和分类之间的映射,以及SHA-256散列。

blocks.en: From the training images of each dataset, 1,500 images were set aside for error probability estimation and 1,000 for internal validation. The former were stratified by class occurrence, object count, and object size. They were further divided into 750 fit images, 375 tuning images, and 375 evaluation images for assessing the error estimator. All boxes from a given image were assigned to the same split. The evaluation images were not used to refit the error probability model or to tune the thresholds or selection methods. The internal validation set was used only to assess the baseline performance and convergence of the target detector and to apply prespecified early stopping. The official validation set was reserved for final evaluation. It was not used for image selection, threshold tuning, early stopping, method choice, or selection of models for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 从每个数据集的培训图像中,留出1 500幅图像用于误差概率估计,1 000幅用于内部验证。 前者按类发生、对象计数和对象大小进行分级。 它们被进一步分为750个适配图像、375个调试图像以及375个评估误差估计器的评价图像。 给定图像中的所有框都被分配到相同的分割中 。 评价图像没有用于重现误差概率模型或调整阈值或选择方法。 内部验证装置仅用于评估目标探测器的基准性能和趋同性,并应用预先指定的早期停止. 正式的鉴定套被保留给最后评价. 它没有用于图像选择、阈值调试、早期停止、方法选择或评价模型的选择。

blocks.en: Because COCO 2017 and BDD100K provide ground-truth annotations, this study was conducted as a retrospective simulation of pool-based active learning. For each image-selection seed, 5% of the candidate images formed the initial labeled set and the remainder formed an unlabeled pool. Four additional batches, each comprising 5% of the candidate images, were then added to the labeled set, with evaluations at 5%, 10%, 15%, 20% and 25%. The candidate set at each stage comprised all eligible images except those already labeled, error-estimation images, internal validation images, and images selected at earlier stages. The ground truth of a candidate image was revealed only after the image was selected.
blocks.zh: 由于COCO 2017和BDD100K提供了地面真实性说明,本研究是作为对基于集合的主动学习的追溯模拟. 对于每个图像选择种子,5%的候选图像组成了初始的标注集,其余的则形成一个没有标注的池. 之后又将另外四批,每批占候选图像的5%,添加到标注的套装中,评价率为5%、10%、15%、20%和25%。 在每个阶段设置的候选图像包括所有符合条件的图像,但已经标注的图像、误算图像、内部验证图像和早期选定的图像除外。 候选人图像的地面真相只有在图像被选中后才被披露.

blocks.en: Object detectors and initialization
blocks.zh: 物体探测器和初始化

blocks.en: The main analysis used YOLOv8n, a light single-stage detector of the YOLOv8 family [ 24 ] with an input resolution of 640 and an effective batch size of 16, including gradient accumulation. The implementation environment used Ultralytics 8.4.101, PyTorch 2.13.0, and torchvision 0.28.0. For initialization, only the weights of the YOLOv8n backbone pretrained on ImageNet classification whose structure, layer names, and array shapes matched the target exactly were loaded. The feature fusion and detection head parts were initialized anew. The initialization record lists the weights that were and were not loaded, any shape mismatches, and the hash of the original weight file. It also confirms that no pretrained weights were loaded into the detection head.
blocks.zh: 主分析采用了YOLOv8n,是YOLOv8家族的轻单级探测器[24],输入分辨率为640,有效批量尺寸为16,包括梯度积累. 实施环境使用Ultralytics 8.4.101,PyTorch 2.13.0和火炬视觉0.2.8. 就初始化而言,只有YOLOv8n主干线的权重在ImageNet分类上预先训练,其结构,层名和阵列形状都与目标完全匹配。 特性聚变和检测头部部件重新初始化。 初始化记录列出曾经和没有加载的重量,任何形状不匹配,以及原始重量文件的散列. 它还证实没有预先训练过的重量装入探测头.

blocks.en: For each combination of dataset, image-selection seed, and model-training seed, all methods shared the initial labeled set, candidate set, optimizer, learning rate schedule, data augmentation, input resolution, effective batch size, and evaluation rules. All methods proceeded from a model trained on 5% of the labeled data to models trained on 10%, and the SHA-256 hashes of the shared weights and labeled set were recorded. YOLOv8n was trained with stochastic gradient descent (initial learning rate 0.01, linear decay to 0.0001 within each stage, momentum 0.937, weight decay 0.0005, three warm-up epochs) with mosaic augmentation in every epoch, HSV jitter, translation of up to 10%, scaling of up to 50%, and horizontal flipping with probability 0.5. The first stage was trained for 20 epochs. Stages two to five were trained for 6 epochs each, and the final model of each stage was evaluated. The learning-rate schedule restarted at each stage, whereas the weights continued from the previous stage. From stage two onward, each method resumed training from its final model of the previous stage. The official validation set was not used during training. The full-label reference runs monitored only mAP@[0.50:0.95] on the internal validation set and stopped between 20 and 200 epochs when no improvement of at least 0.001 was observed for 20 consecutive epochs. The model that first reached the best value served as the reference. The model from the final epoch was also saved.
blocks.zh: 对于数据集,图像选择种子,模型训练种子的每一种组合,所有方法都共享了初始的标注集,候选集,优化器,学习速率表,数据增强,输入分辨率,有效批量大小,评价规则. 所有方法都从5%的标签数据培训模型到10%的培训模型,并记录了共享重量和标签集的SHA-256散列。 YOLOv8n接受了具有历史意义的梯度递减(初始学习率0.01,每个阶段线性衰变至0.0001,动力0.937,重量衰变0.0005,三个温暖的时代)的训练,每个时代都有杂交增生,HSV颤抖,翻译率高达10%,缩放率高达50%,水平翻转概率为0.5%. 第一阶段培训了20个世纪。 第二至第五阶段培训了6个世纪,对每个阶段的最终模式进行了评估。 学习率时间表在每个阶段重新开始,而加权则从前一阶段开始。 从第二阶段开始,每种方法都从前一阶段的最后模式恢复培训。 在培训期间没有使用正式的验证装置。 全标签引用运行在内部验证集上仅监控mAP@[0.50:0.95],并在连续20个纪元未观察到至少0.001的改进时在20至200个纪元之间停止. 最初达到最佳价值的模型作为参考。 最终时代的模型也被保存下来.

blocks.en: To assess sensitivity to training time, the supplementary experiment used YOLOv8n and BDD100K with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1. All five stages were trained for 40 epochs. For the five prespecified methods (proposed method, random sampling, external-feature k k -center, BADGE, and output-entropy selection), the data splits, initially labeled images, optimizer, input resolution, effective batch size, and official evaluation rules were the same. The five methods proceeded from the same model trained on 5% of the labeled data to models trained on 10% of the labeled data. Matching SHA-256 hashes for the initial model weights and labeled set were confirmed. Thereafter, each resumed training using its own final model from the previous stage. Rarity-only selection was added to this experiment after the results of the five methods had been observed. It was run as one additional trajectory under the same conditions and schedule, starting from the same 5% model (checkpoint and model-state hashes verified), with the same selection rule as in the main analysis and without the replacement rules of the proposed method. Its official evaluation used the same evaluation protocol, images, and ground truth as the five methods, and the paired bootstrap was recomputed with the five-method values unchanged.
blocks.zh: 为了评估对训练时间的敏感性,补充实验使用YOLOv8n和BDD100K的图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1. 所有五个阶段都为40个时代进行了培训。 对于五种预先指定的方法(拟议方法,随机抽样,外部feature k-center,BADGE,以及输出-entropy选择),数据分割,最初标注的图像,优化器,输入分辨率,有效批量大小,以及官方评价规则是相同的. 这五种方法从同一模型开始,对5%的标签数据进行了培训,对10%的标签数据进行了培训。 初步型号重量和标签集的SHA-256散列匹配得到确认. 此后,每个学员都使用自己从前一阶段起的最后模式恢复培训。 在观察了这五种方法的结果之后,在这项实验中增加了只有瑞丽选择. 它在同样的条件下和时间表下作为另一个轨迹运行,从相同的5%模型(检查点和模型状态散列)开始,选择规则与主分析相同,没有拟议方法的替换规则。 其官方评价采用与五种方法相同的评价协议,图像,和地面真理,配对的靴子与五种方法值重合不变.

blocks.en: Data selection methods compared
blocks.zh: 比较数据选择方法

blocks.en: All six methods listed in Table Data selection methods compared were compared for the two seed conditions. Each method added the same number of images at each stage. The ground-truth annotations of the candidate and official validation images, as well as performance on the official validation images, were not used for image selection. The supplementary Faster R-CNN comparison used the proposed method, BADGE, and rarity-only selection. The labeled fractions included only images used to train the detector. The proposed method, and the two matched-comparison criteria derived from it (outputs and box information only, and internal features shuffled across images), additionally used the separate 1,500-image labeled set to fit, tune, and evaluate the error estimator. Random sampling, external-feature k k -center selection, BADGE, output-entropy selection, and rarity-only selection did not use that set.
blocks.zh: 就两个种子条件比较了表数据选择方法列出的所有六种方法。 每一种方法在每个阶段都加入了相同的图像数量. 候选人的地面真实说明和官方验证图像以及官方验证图像上的性能没有用于图像选择. 补充的快速R-CNN比较采用了拟议的方法BADGE和罕见的仅选. 标注的分数仅包括用于训练探测器的图像. 提议的方法,以及从它衍生出来的两个匹配的比较标准(仅输出和盒式信息,以及内部特征在图像之间摇摆),还另外使用了单独的1500图像标签集来适应,调谐,并评价误差估计器. 随机采样,外部特性 k - center 选择, BADGE, 输出- 内置选择, 以及 稀有- 仅选择没有使用此集 。

blocks.en: The external-feature k k -center selection used ResNet-50 with ImageNet-1K V2 weights and the official image transforms provided by Torchvision [ 27 ] . This ResNet-50 was separate from the detector under training and was not used to train or evaluate the target detector. Features were generated once per image and stored as 32-bit floating-point values in image-ID order. The distance metric was the squared Euclidean distance after L2 normalization, with ties broken by ascending image ID. The method receives none of the trained weights, internal features, outputs, gradients, predicted boxes, or ground-truth annotations of the target detector.
blocks.zh: 外部地物 k -center 选择使用 ResNet-50 并带有 ImageNet-1K V2 重量和 火炬Vision 提供的官方图像转换 [27]. 这个ResNet-50与正在训练的探测器分开,没有用于训练或评价目标探测器. 特性每个图像一次生成,按照图像ID顺序作为32位浮点值存储. 距离度量是L2正常化后方形的欧几里得距离,其联系被上升的图像ID打破. 该方法不接收训练有素的重量、内部特征、输出、梯度、预测箱或目标探测器的地面真实说明。

blocks.en: The output-entropy method computes − p ​ log ⁡ p − ( 1 − p ) ​ log ⁡ ( 1 − p ) -p\log p-(1-p)\log(1-p) from the top-class confidence p p of each predicted box with confidence of at least 0.05, averages the values within the image, and assigns the maximum value log ⁡ 2 \log 2 to an image without such boxes. The same treatment was used at all stages. The BADGE comparator is an adaptation of BADGE [ 12 ] to object detection. The original method forms, for each candidate, the gradient of the last-layer loss using the predicted label as a hypothetical label and selects a batch by k k -means++ seeding on these gradient embeddings. A detector produces a variable number of boxes per image, so we replaced the gradient embedding with an image-level embedding: the mean over the post-NMS boxes of the per-box internal feature vector (the same pooling used for stratification), L2-normalized and multiplied by an image uncertainty of 1 minus the maximum box confidence (1 for an image without detections). The batch is drawn by k k -means++ seeding. The first image is chosen uniformly at random, and each subsequent image is sampled with probability proportional to the squared distance to the nearest image already selected, with the random state set by the image-selection seed. This adaptation retains the combination of uncertainty and diversity in the target model’s representation but does not use loss gradients or hypothetical labels. We therefore do not treat it as a reproduction of the original algorithm.
blocks.zh: 输出 - 输入法计算 − p log − (p − p ) log − (p − p ) - p\ log p - (p )\ log p - (p )\ p 从每个预测框的顶级置信 p 中, 置信度至少为 0.05, 平均图像中的值, 指定最大值日志 − 2\ log 2 到一个没有此类框的图像中. 在所有阶段都采用了同样的处理办法。 BADGE比较器是BADGE [12] 对对象检测的改编. 原始方法对每个候选者使用预测的标签作为假设的标签来形成末层损失的梯度,并在这些梯度嵌入上以 k - 意指++ 选择一个批次的种子. 一个探测器每个图像产生一个可变的框数,因此我们用一个图像级别嵌入来代替梯度嵌入:在每盒内部特性矢量(用于分层的相同集合)的NMS后框上的平均值,L2-正态化并乘以1减去最大盒置信度的图像不确定性(1对于一个没有检测的图像). 批次由k k - 意为++ 播种. 第一个图像是统一随机选择的,每个后续的图像都以与已选择的最近图像的平方距离成比例的概率进行抽样,由图像选择种子设置随机状态. 这一调整保留了目标模型代表性中的不确定性和多样性的组合,但没有使用损失梯度或假设的标签。 因此,我们不把它作为原始算法的复制。

blocks.en: One cycle of active learning with the proposed method
blocks.zh: 用拟议方法积极学习的一个周期

blocks.en: The proposed method builds the labeled set in the following stages:
blocks.zh: 拟议方法构建了下列阶段的标签集:

blocks.en: 1. At each stage with 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% of the candidate images labeled, train the target detector on the current labeled set. Fix the trained detector and run inference on all remaining unlabeled candidate images. 2. For each predicted box, estimate the posterior probabilities of six mutually exclusive outcomes from the target detector’s internal features, final outputs, and box geometry: correct, classification error, localization error, combined classification and localization error, duplicate detection, and background false positive. 3. Weight the posterior probability of each error type by that error’s estimated effect on the current AP and sum the weighted probabilities within each image. Discount the lower bound of this sum according to the number of correct predictions of the same predicted class obtained from the error-estimation images, and divide by the estimated annotation effort to obtain the image’s selection priority. 4. Draw the next 5% of images uniformly at random as the reference set. Among images with the same predicted classes, predicted object count, predicted object size and similar internal features, match low-priority images inside the reference set with high-priority images outside it. Replace an image only if the priority difference exceeds a fixed threshold after accounting for the stability bounds and if the composition of the selected images does not change excessively. If no image meets the conditions, leave the reference set unchanged. 5. Treat the existing annotations of the selected images as revealed only after the selection is final. Add the selected images to the labeled set and train the detector of the next stage. Repeat until 25% is reached. An image once selected is not returned to the unlabeled pool.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 在每个阶段,标注5%,10%,15%或20%的候选图像,在目前标注的套装上训练目标探测器. 修复训练有素的探测器,对所有未加标签的候选图像进行推论。 2. 对于每个预测框,估计目标探测器内部特征、最终输出和框几何六个相互排斥的结果的后概率:正确、分类错误、本地化错误、合并分类和本地化错误、重复检测和背景假阳性。 3. 通过误差对当前AP的估计影响来加权每种误差类型的后概率,并总和每个图像中的加权概率。 根据从误差估计图像中获取的相同预测类的正确预测数,对这个和数的下限进行折扣,除以估计的注解努力,以获得图像的选择优先. 4. 随机绘制下5%的图像作为参考。 在具有相同预测类,预测对象计数,预测对象大小和类似内部特征的图像中,将参考集内的低优先级图像与其外侧的高优先级图像匹配. 仅当优先级差在计算稳定性界限后超过固定阈值,且选定图像的构成没有过度变化时,才替换图像。 如果图像不符合条件,则不改变引用集. 5. 仅在选定完成后才将选定图像的现有说明视为已披露。 将选中的图像添加到标签集, 并训练下一阶段的探测器 。 重复,直到达到25%。 选中的图像不会返回到未标记的池中 。

blocks.en: At each stage with 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% of the candidate images labeled, train the target detector on the current labeled set. Fix the trained detector and run inference on all remaining unlabeled candidate images.
blocks.zh: 在每个阶段,标注5%,10%,15%或20%的候选图像,在目前标注的套装上训练目标探测器. 修复训练有素的探测器,对所有未加标签的候选图像进行推论。

blocks.en: For each predicted box, estimate the posterior probabilities of six mutually exclusive outcomes from the target detector’s internal features, final outputs, and box geometry: correct, classification error, localization error, combined classification and localization error, duplicate detection, and background false positive.
blocks.zh: 对于每个预测的框,估计目标探测器内部特征,最终输出,和框几何六个相互排斥的结果的后概率:正确,分类错误,本地化错误,合并分类和本地化错误,重复检测,以及背景假阳性.

blocks.en: Weight the posterior probability of each error type by that error’s estimated effect on the current AP and sum the weighted probabilities within each image. Discount the lower bound of this sum according to the number of correct predictions of the same predicted class obtained from the error-estimation images, and divide by the estimated annotation effort to obtain the image’s selection priority.
blocks.zh: 通过错误对当前 AP 的估计影响来加权每种错误类型的后概率, 并总和每个图像中的加权概率 。 根据从误差估计图像中获取的相同预测类的正确预测数,对这个和数的下限进行折扣,除以估计的注解努力,以获得图像的选择优先.

blocks.en: Draw the next 5% of images uniformly at random as the reference set. Among images with the same predicted classes, predicted object count, predicted object size and similar internal features, match low-priority images inside the reference set with high-priority images outside it. Replace an image only if the priority difference exceeds a fixed threshold after accounting for the stability bounds and if the composition of the selected images does not change excessively. If no image meets the conditions, leave the reference set unchanged.
blocks.zh: 随机绘制下5%的图像作为参考。 在具有相同预测类,预测对象计数,预测对象大小和类似内部特征的图像中,将参考集内的低优先级图像与其外侧的高优先级图像匹配. 仅当优先级差在计算稳定性界限后超过固定阈值,且选定图像的构成没有过度变化时,才替换图像。 如果图像不符合条件,则不改变引用集.

blocks.en: Treat the existing annotations of the selected images as revealed only after the selection is final. Add the selected images to the labeled set and train the detector of the next stage. Repeat until 25% is reached. An image once selected is not returned to the unlabeled pool.
blocks.zh: 仅在选定完成后才将所选图像的现有注释作为显示。 将选中的图像添加到标签集, 并训练下一阶段的探测器 。 重复,直到达到25%。 选中的图像不会返回到未标记的池中 。

blocks.en: The proposed method does not simply capture the images with the highest total error probabilities. It considers the effect of each error type, the number of correct predictions of the same predicted class, the expected annotation effort, the composition of the selected images, and the stability of the estimates under box resampling, and reselects only images for which there is evidence to set aside the random draw. Selection uses the predicted boxes retained after nonmaximum suppression (NMS). The confidence threshold for retention was 0.001 for YOLOv8n and 0.05 for Faster R-CNN. The IoU threshold for NMS was 0.7 for YOLOv8n, 0.5 for the ROI head, and 0.7 for the region proposal network of Faster R-CNN. The contributions of at most 100 predicted boxes per image were summed.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法并非简单地捕捉总误差概率最高的图像。 它考虑了每个错误类型的效果,同一预测类的正确预测数量,预期的注释努力,所选图像的构成,以及框重印下估计的稳定性,只重新选择有证据证明可以撇开随机抽取的图像. 选择使用非最大压制(NMS)后保留的预测框. YOLOv8n的置信阈值为0.001,而更快的R-CNN为0.05。 NMS的IoU阈值是YOLOv8n的0.7,ROI头的0.5,更快R-CNN的区域建议网络的0.7。 对每个图像最多100个预测箱的贡献进行了总结。

blocks.en: Box-level error types
blocks.zh: 框级错误类型

blocks.en: The proposed method takes as its unit of inference the predicted boxes that the detector outputs after NMS, which suppresses redundant overlapping predictions of the same object and uses at most 100 boxes per image at the time of selection. In calibration images for which labels were available, predicted boxes were matched to ground-truth boxes by TIDE-compatible rules. Each predicted box was assigned to exactly one of six types: correct, classification error, localization error, combined classification and localization error, duplicate detection, or background false positive [ 20 ] . The main analysis used an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 for matching, where IoU represents the degree of overlap between a predicted box and a ground-truth box. A predicted box whose maximum IoU with any ground-truth box was below 0.1 was classified as a background false positive.
blocks.zh: 拟议方法将探测器在NMS之后输出的预测箱作为推断单位,该预测箱压制了对同一物体的冗余重叠预测,在选择时每个图像最多使用100个箱. 在可提供标签的校准图像中,预测的盒子按照与TIDE兼容的规则与地面真实的盒子匹配。 每个预测的框被分配到精确的六种类型之一:正确,分类错误,本地化错误,合并分类和本地化错误,重复检测,或背景假阳性[20]. 主要分析采用0.5的交叉结合(IoU)阈值进行比对,IoU代表预测箱和地面真实箱之间的重叠程度. 一个预言箱,其最大IoU带任何地面真实盒低于0.1,被归类为背景假阳性.

blocks.en: A missed detection, that is, a ground-truth object with no corresponding predicted box, does not have an internal representation associated with a predicted box. Therefore, missed detections were excluded from the calculation of the box-level error probability and evaluated separately based on the number of misses, recall, and TIDE error decomposition. The “error probability” in this paper is accordingly defined for individual predicted boxes and does not refer to the probability that an image contains at least one error.

blocks.en: For each predicted box b b , we concatenate 3 × 3 3\times 3 local features obtained by ROI Alignment [ 28 ] from the target detector’s multiresolution feature maps, features of an annular region around the box, unnormalized class outputs, top-class confidence, the position and size of the box, and its overlap with and distance from neighboring boxes in the same image. For YOLOv8n, the feature maps are the three inputs of the detection head at strides 8, 16, and 32, ROI-aligned on a 3 × 3 3\times 3 grid at every scale and concatenated. The annular region is obtained by enlarging the box by a factor of 1.5 about its center and is ROI-aligned on a 7 × 7 7\times 7 grid, with the 24 border cells outside the original box retained. The mean and maximum of these cells and the difference between the box-center feature and the ring mean are used. For Faster R-CNN, the internal feature is the 1,024-dimensional output of the box head of the ROI head, and no ring feature is used. All these quantities are associated with the same post-NMS prediction box. Image features extracted by a model other than the detector under training and image metadata were not used for the error probability or the main image selection of the proposed method. The features were standardized and projected onto principal components that explained 95% of the variance, with a maximum of 64 dimensions fitted to the 750 fit images.
