C ^ i \widehat{C}_{i} is estimated from a fixed per-image effort, number of predicted boxes, and their crowding. The true number of ground-truth boxes was not used for selection. Images without detected boxes have B i = 0 B_{i}=0 but remain eligible through random sampling. A i A_{i} is an index for prioritizing images that are predicted to contain errors, adjusted by a relative value computed from the number and crowding of predicted boxes. It does not represent the human labeling time.
blocks.zh: 其中Ai A_{i}为选择优先级,Ai UCB A_{i}^{\ mathrm{UCB}}}为其上限. 这些边框量化了分数在图像中重新模拟预测的框的敏感性,条件是安装了误差估计器和误差类型的加权. 它们是热力稳定性的界限,而不是为真正的错误负担或再培训的收益而调整的信任间隔。 例如,一个带有单一预测框的图像有相同的界限,尽管该框的误差概率仍然不确定. A i Açíi} 使用下限, 使得在框重印下得分不稳定的图像不会获得更高的优先级 。 C ^ i\glash{C}_{i}是从固定的每个图像努力,预测的框数,以及它们的拥挤度来估计的. 选择时没有使用真实的地面真实框数 。 没有检测到的框的图像有B i = 0 B _{i}=0,但通过随机抽样仍然符合条件. Ai Açíi} 是一个用于优先排序预言含有错误的图像的索引, 由预测框的数量和挤占量计算的相对值调整 。 它不代表人类的标签时间。

blocks.en: Replacement between images with matching characteristics
blocks.zh: 在具有匹配特性的图像之间替换

blocks.en: For each image-selection seed, the random selection and the proposed method were initialized from the same uniformly random set of images R R . Candidate images were stratified by the set of predicted classes, the number of predicted boxes in bins of 0, 1 to 2, 3 to 5, 6 to 10, and 11 or more, the dominant predicted object size in the COCO small, medium, and large bins (areas below 32 2 32^{2} , from 32 2 32^{2} to below 96 2 96^{2} , and 96 2 96^{2} or above, respectively), and one of eight k k -means clusters formed from the standardized mean internal feature of each image (random state 0, 10 initializations). A low-priority image i i inside R R is matched with a high-priority image j j outside R R in the same stratum. Image i i is replaced by j j only if A j LCB > A i UCB A_{j}^{\mathrm{LCB}}>A_{i}^{\mathrm{UCB}} and the evidence margin A j LCB − A i UCB A_{j}^{\mathrm{LCB}}-A_{i}^{\mathrm{UCB}} exceeds a prespecified δ \delta . None of the images were used more than once. Among the candidates with the same evidence margin, the image farthest from the already selected images in the internal-feature space was selected first.
blocks.zh: 对于每个图像选择的种子,随机选择和拟议方法都是从相同的统一随机的一组图像R R 初始化的. 候选人的图像按一组预测的类别进行分级,以0、1至2、3至5、6至10和11个或更多方式预测的箱数,COCO中小、中和大箱中的主要预测对象大小(面积从32 2 32 ===================================================================================================================================================================================================== R内部的低优先级图像 i 与R外的高优先级图像 j j 匹配在同一层. 图像 i 只在 A j LCB > 的情况下被 j 替换为 j 。 iUCB A_{j}^{\ mathrm{LCB}}>i}^{\ mathrm{UCB}}和证据比值 Aj LCB− - AiUCB A_{j}^{\ mathrm{LCB}}-A_{i}^{\i}^{\ mathrm{UCB}} > 超过预先指定的 δ\ delta 。 图像没有一次以上使用。 在具有相同证据边距的候选人中,首先选择了与内部空间中已经选中的图像最远的图像.

blocks.en: At most 50% of the random draw was replaced. Replacements that would change the marginal distributions of the predicted class, predicted object size, or number of predicted boxes beyond tolerance were not accepted. The change was measured by the Jensen–Shannon divergence. Images without predicted boxes were used neither as replacements nor as images to be replaced and remained in the selection only when they were included in the random draw. The share of images with zero or one predicted box at a confidence of 0.25 or above was kept from falling below their share in the random draw. In addition, the proportions of classes of the dominant-size and object-count bins, computed from all predicted boxes retained for selection, had to remain within the central 95% range, that is, between the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, of 1,000 resamples of the random draw. When the evidence for replacement was insufficient, a random draw was retained. These constraints prevented the selection from concentrating on particular groups of images and allowed the contribution of internal error information to be compared under matched conditions.
blocks.zh: 最多50%的随机抽签被替换. 将改变预测类的边际分布、预测对象大小或超出容忍度的预测框数的替换不被接受。 这一变化以Jensen-Shannon的分歧来衡量。 没有预测框的图像既不用作替换,也不用作要替换的图像,只有在被包括在随机图中时才留在选择中. 以0.25或以上置信度为零或一个预测框的图像份额不低于其在随机抽取中的份额。 此外,从所有预留供选择的框中计算出的占支配地位的大小和对象计数箱的类别比例必须保持在95%的中央范围,即2.5至97.5百分位之间,即1000个随机抽取的复标。 当替换证据不足时,保留了随机抽取。 这些限制使选择无法集中于特定组图像,并使得内部错误信息在相应条件下进行比较。

blocks.en: In the experiments, the evidence margin required for replacement was fixed at δ = 1.35 × 10 − 7 \delta=1.35\times 10^{-7} , and the upper limit of the Jensen–Shannon divergence was set at 0.00561. The Jensen–Shannon divergence and shares of images with zero or one box were checked on boxes with a confidence of 0.25 or above, whereas the resampled composition range was calculated using all boxes retained for selection.
blocks.zh: 在实验中,更换所需的证据比值被固定在 = 1.35 × 1.10 − 7\delta= 1.35\times 10^{-7}, Jensen–Shannon 差值的上限定为 0.00561. Jensen-Shannon的偏差和带有零或一个盒子的图像份额在0.25或以上置信度的盒子上进行了检查,而重印的构成范围则使用保留供选择的所有盒子计算。

blocks.en: Additional experiment that changed only the selection criterion under matched conditions
blocks.zh: 仅在相应条件下更改选择标准的补充试验

blocks.en: To examine the difference between linking the internal representation to errors and using representation rarity alone, we ran a single comparison from the common model trained on 10% of the labeled data to the 15% labeled-data level, with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1. The starting model, candidate set, maximum number of replaced images, stratification, constraints on the selection distribution, model-training seed, optimizer, data augmentation, number of training epochs, and evaluation method were identical. Only the selection priority was changed. Four criteria were compared, including that of the proposed method. The first is the proposed method, which uses the error probability p t , b ∗ p^{*}_{t,b} . The method combines internal features, outputs, and box information. The second, “outputs and box information only,” does not use internal features for error-probability estimation. It uses the posterior p t , b output p^{\mathrm{output}}_{t,b} of the outputs-and-box model described above in place of p t , b ∗ p^{*}_{t,b} (implementation name output_matched_replace ). The per-type weights w t w_{t} , evidence sufficiency q i q_{i} , estimated effort C ^ i \widehat{C}_{i} , and stability bounds of the priority, stratification, and replacement rules are identical to those of the proposed method. The output-entropy selection of the main analysis differs from this criterion in that it aggregates the binary entropy of the top-class confidence within an image and selects directly from the top without error types, weights, or replacements. Third, under the “internal features shuffled across images” criterion, the internal features of each predicted box are replaced at random with those of another box of the same predicted class and the same predicted size bin. The shuffle is applied independently to the fit, tuning, evaluation, and candidate splits using random numbers derived deterministically from the dataset, seeds, split, and stage. The outputs, box information, neighbor information, and assignment of boxes to images are held fixed. The error-probability model, temperature-scaling parameter, and ρ t , c \rho_{t,c} are then re-estimated on the shuffled features, and images are selected with the same weighting and replacement rules as the proposed method (implementation name shuffled_internal_matched_replace ). This criterion controls for the contribution of image-specific information carried by the internal features. The strata used for matching were defined from the unshuffled internal features and shared by all four criteria. Fourth, selection by the rarity of the internal representation alone uses no error labels, per-type posteriors, or error probabilities. It only checks how far a candidate image’s internal features lie from the labeled set (implementation name generic_internal_novelty_matched_replace ).
blocks.zh: 为了检查将内部代表与错误联系起来与仅使用代表稀有的区别,我们从10%的标注数据所训练的共同模型到15%的标注数据水平,进行了单一的比较,图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1. 起始模型,候选集,被替换图像的最大数量,分层,选择分布的限制,模型训练种子,优化者,数据增强,训练时代的数量,以及评价方法都是一样的. 只更改了选择优先级 。 比较了四项标准,包括拟议方法的标准。 第一种是采用错误概率p t, b * p^{*}_{t, b}的拟议方法. 该方法结合了内部特征,输出,和框信息. 第二,“只提供产出和盒式信息”,没有使用内部特征进行误差概率估计。 它使用上述输出和框模型的后 p t, b 输出 p^{\ mathrm{output}}_{t, b} 代替 p t, b *^{*}_{ t, b} ( 执行名输出_ 匹配_ 替换). 每类权重 w t w_{t}, 证据充足 q i q_{i}, 估计的努力 C^ i\ gladhat{ C}_{i}, 以及优先权,分层和替换规则的稳定性界限与拟议方法相同. 主分析的输出-内向选择与这个标准不同,因为它将顶级置信度的二进制聚合到图像内,直接从顶部选择,没有错误类型,权重,或替换. 第三,在“横跨图像的内部特征”标准下,每个预测框的内部特征随机替换为预测类和预测大小相同的另一个框的内部特征。 洗牌被独立应用到适配,调音,评价,以及选手的分裂中,使用从数据集,种子,分裂,和阶段中从随机数中得出决定性的分数. 输出、框信息、邻居信息以及指定框用于图像是固定的。 错误概率模型,温度缩放参数,以及 $ t, c\rho_{t, c} 然后在被洗涤的特性上重新估计, 并且选择图像时使用与拟议方法相同的加权和替换规则( 执行名称 shuffled_ Internal_ matched_ replace ) 。 这一标准控制了内部特征所携带的图像特定信息的贡献. 用于匹配的层由未洗刷的内部特性定义,并被所有四项标准所共享。 第四,仅通过内部代表的罕见性进行选择,没有使用错误标签,每个类型的后缀,或错误概率. 它只检查候选图像的内部特征与标注的套件相距有多远(执行名称通用_innovelty_ matched_place).

blocks.en: The primary measure for comparing the selection rules was the difference in mAP@[0.50:0.95] on the official validation set at the matched 15% point. The rate at which the selected images actually contained errors was a secondary measure computed after selection using the ground-truth annotations. It was not used to tune priorities or thresholds, or to reselect images for any comparator method.
blocks.zh: 比较选择规则的主要尺度是对应15%点的官方验证设置上的mAP@[0.50:0.95]差异. 所选图像实际包含错误的速度是使用地面真实说明进行选择后计算的次要尺度。 它不用于调试优先次序或阈值,也不用于重选任何参照方法的图像。

blocks.en: Verification of selection behavior from sealed records
blocks.zh: 从密封记录中核实选择行为

blocks.en: For the proposed method and BADGE, we retrieved the selected image IDs and selection summaries saved at every cycle for two conditions: image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1 and image-selection seed 18 with model-training seed 0. There were eight experiments (two datasets, two seed conditions, and two methods), and for each experiment, the selected image IDs and summaries of cycles one to four amounted to 64 artifacts in total. The SHA-256 hash and size of each file were checked against the artifact manifest sealed when the experiment concluded and against the published records.
blocks.zh: 就拟议方法和BADGE而言,我们检索了每个周期保存的选定图像ID和选择摘要,有两个条件:图像选择种子11带有模型训练种子1,图像选择种子18带有模型训练种子 零点 共进行了8次实验(2个数据集,2个种子条件,2个方法),对每次实验,选取的图像ID和1至4个周期的摘要共64件文物. SHA-256散列物和每个文件的大小与试验结束时密封的文物清单和已公布的记录核对。

blocks.en: For the proposed method, we tallied the number of images actually replaced from the random draw at each stage, the number of candidates rejected because their margins were below the threshold, and the replacement rate. The overlap with the selections of BADGE was reported as the number of shared images and the Jaccard index. Because the two methods have different parent models after retraining, this comparison describes their selection behavior and does not isolate the effect of error information alone.
blocks.zh: 就拟议方法而言,我们计算了每个阶段从随机抽取中实际替换的图像数量、因边距低于门槛而被拒绝的候选人数量以及替换率。 与BADGE选择的重叠被报道为共享图像的数量和Jaccard索引. 由于这两种方法在再培训后有不同的母模型,因此这一比较描述了他们的选择行为,并不单独隔离错误信息的效果.

blocks.en: Experiment matrix and observation points
blocks.zh: 实验矩阵和观测点

blocks.en: The main analysis comprised 24 learning curves: YOLOv8n, two datasets, two seed conditions, and six methods. The supplementary Faster R-CNN comparison comprised six learning curves: two datasets, image-selection seed 11 with model-training seed 1, and three methods. The 40-epoch supplementary experiment comprised five prespecified learning curves on BDD100K and one additional learning curve for rarity-only selection. Each learning curve had five observation points at 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25% labeled data, and all methods within a dataset, detector, and seed condition shared the same model trained on 5% of the labeled data. The matched additional experiment, which changed only the selection criterion, started from the common model trained on 10% of the labeled data and extended to the 15% labeled-data level, with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1. The configuration, selected images, trained models, and run history of each curve were fixed, and the official validation set was evaluated using a single evaluation implementation.
blocks.zh: 主要分析包括24个学习曲线:YOLOv8n,两个数据集,两个种子条件,以及六个方法. 补充的快速R-CNN比较包括六个学习曲线:两个数据集、图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1以及三种方法。 40世纪的补充实验包括BDD100K上的5个预先指定的学习曲线和另外1个仅用于稀有选择的学习曲线. 每个学习曲线有5个观测点,有5个、10个、15个、20个和25%的标记数据,在一个数据集、探测器和种子状况中的所有方法都共享了5%标记数据上训练过的同一模型。 匹配的附加实验仅改变了选择标准,从10%的标注数据培训的通用模型开始,扩展至15%的标注数据级别,图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1. 配置,选取的图像,训练过的模型,以及运行每个曲线的历史都得到了固定,官方的验证集使用单一的评价执行来评价.

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 评价尺度

blocks.en: The detection performance was measured mainly using mAP@[0.50:0.95] across all official evaluation images of each dataset. AP50, AP75, per-class AP, AP by object size, precision, recall, and TIDE error breakdown were also examined. The primary effect size for comparison between methods was the normalized area under the learning curve: mAP@[0.50:0.95] as a function of the labeled fraction x ∈ { 0.05 , 0.10 , 0.15 , 0.20 , 0.25 } x\in\{0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.25\} , integrated using the trapezoidal rule and divided by the 0.20 width of the range. This value corresponds to the mean mAP from 5% to 25% labeled data and is not calculated per selected image.

The selection behavior was described by the number of replacements from the sealed artifacts, the replacement rate per stage, and the Jaccard index between the selected sets of the proposed method and BADGE. The number of true errors per 100 images was also reported in the matched comparison at the 15% labeled-data level with image-selection seed 11 and model-training seed 1, which changed only the selection criterion.
blocks.zh: 选择行为由密封文物的替换数量,每个阶段的替换率,以及拟议方法的选定套和BADGE之间的Jaccard索引来描述. 每100幅图像的真实错误数目也报告在15%的标签数据级别与图像选择种子11和模型训练种子1的匹配比较中,这只改变了选择标准。

blocks.en: Statistics and reproducibility
blocks.zh: 统计和可复制性

blocks.en: Statistical analyses
blocks.zh: 统计分析

blocks.en: For each detector, dataset, and pair of image-selection and model-training seeds, the mAP at 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25% labeled data was integrated using the trapezoidal rule and divided by the 0.20 width of the range to obtain the normalized area under the learning curve. In the YOLOv8n main analysis, the differences between the proposed method and rarity-only selection, BADGE, output-entropy selection, external-feature k k -center selection, and random sampling were computed using the matched dataset, image-selection seed, model-training seed, and evaluation images. For the five comparisons under each of the four conditions, 95% intervals were obtained by resampling the evaluation images. In the supplementary Faster R-CNN comparison, the differences of the proposed method from BADGE and rarity-only selection were similarly computed for the two datasets. In a sensitivity analysis that excluded the shared starting point, the mean of the learning curve and the differences between the methods were computed over the four points at 10%, 15%, 20%, and 25%, excluding the 5% point.
blocks.zh: 对于每个探测器,数据集,以及一对图像选择和模型训练种子,MAP在5,10,15,20,和25%的标注数据采用tapezoidal规则进行集成,除以范围0.20宽以获得学习曲线下的正常化区域. 在YOLOv8n主分析中,采用匹配的数据集、图像选择种子、模型培训种子和评价图像计算了拟议方法与仅稀有选择、BADGE、输出进取选择、外部特性k-中心选择和随机抽样之间的差异。 在四个条件中的每一个条件下的五个比较中,95%的间隔都是通过对评价图像进行重新取样获得的。 在补充的快速R-CNN比较中,对两个数据集同样计算出拟议方法与BADGE和稀有选择的区别。 在排除了共同起点的敏感性分析中,学习曲线的平均值以及方法之间的差别在四个点上计算为10%、15%、20%和25%,不包括5%。

blocks.en: To express the variation from changing the evaluation images with the trained models fixed, the same images were matched across methods and resampled 10,000 times with resampling seed 20260728, and the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the difference formed the 95% interval. Each resampled image set was shared by all methods and all labeled fractions, and the AP of each resample was recomputed from the per-image matching records of the official evaluation rather than from per-image AP values. These intervals do not include variation arising from repeated training or image selection with different image-selection or model-training seeds. The two seed conditions were reported separately, and we did not use them to estimate the confidence intervals or rank probabilities over other seeds.
blocks.zh: 为了表达在用经过训练的固定模型改变评价图像方面的变化,同样的图像经过了各种方法的匹配,并用20260728号种子重印了10 000次,差额的2.5和97.5百分位数构成了95%的间隔。 每个重印的图像集被所有的方法和所有标注的分数共享,每个重印的AP从官方评价的每个图像匹配记录中重编,而不是从每个图像的AP值中重编. 这些间隔不包括因反复训练或用不同图像选择或模型训练种子选择图像而产生的变化。 这两个种子条件分别报告,我们没有用它们来估计信任间隔或对其他种子的概率。

blocks.en: For the additional experiment at the 15% labeled-data level, which changed only the selection criterion, differences were computed using the same official evaluation images with 95% intervals from 10,000 resamples in which the evaluation images were matched across criteria. Analyses by class and error type were used to describe the breakdown of the overall performance difference and are not treated as standalone tests of superiority. Each combination of the detector, dataset, seed pair, and selection method was trained once. The only replication over random numbers was in the two conditions with different image-selection and model-training seeds. No further replicates were run. The official evaluation set contains 5,000 images from COCO 2017 and 10,000 images from BDD100K. No null hypothesis tests were performed, and the intervals were used descriptively. Therefore, no correction for multiple comparisons was applied.
blocks.zh: 附加的15%标签数据层面的实验仅改变了选择标准,对差异的计算使用相同的官方评价图像,其间隔为95%,与10 000个重新标注的评价图像相匹配。 按类别和误差类型的分析被用于描述总体性能差异的分解,不作为优势的独立测试处理. 探测器,数据集,种子配对和选择方法的每个组合都接受了一次培训. 唯一比随机数的复制是在两种条件下,有不同的图像选择和模型训练种子. 没有进行进一步的复制。 官方评价集收录了COCO 2017的5000幅图像和BDD100K的10,000幅图像. 没有进行无假说试验,而且间隔是描述性的。 因此,没有对多项比较进行更正。

blocks.en: Label efficiency and computational efficiency
blocks.zh: 标签效率和计算效率

blocks.en: The methods were compared for the same labeled fractions. Because comparable human labeling and GPU times were not obtained across methods, reductions in labeling or computing time were not evaluated as primary outcomes. The 1,500 images that the proposed method uses for error probability estimation were treated as development resources, separate from the labeled set used for selection.
blocks.zh: 对同一标签分数的方法进行了比较。 由于不同方法没有获得可比较的人类标签和GPU时间,因此没有将标签或计算时间的减少作为主要结果进行评估。 将拟议方法用于误差概率估计的1 500幅图像作为开发资源,与用于选择的标签集分开。

blocks.en: Missing data and run history
blocks.zh: 缺少数据和运行历史

blocks.en: The six-method comparison was not performed for a YOLOv8n dataset and seed condition if either the learning curve or the official evaluation for any of the six methods were missing. The supplementary Faster R-CNN comparison required all three methods for a dataset. Missing values were neither interpolated nor extrapolated. Runs resumed from a saved training stage were treated as continuations of the original experiment, after the identity of the saved stage had been verified using a hash. The final comparisons used only learning curves in which the SHA-256 hashes of the model weights and labeled set for the model trained on 5% of the labeled data matched across the compared methods within each dataset, detector, and seed condition.
